item.title: Twenty Years of Giving SMEs a Voice: Wayne Lim and The Journey Behind MALAYSIA SME
item.description: When Wayne Lim founded MALAYSIA SME in 2005, small and medium enterprises were rarely at the centre of business reporting. Twenty years on, his commitment to focus, consistency and credibility has helped shape one of Malaysia’s most enduring SME-focused media platforms. As MALAYSIA SME marks its 20th anniversary, Lim reflects on the journey so far and looks ahead to new ambitions that blend entrepreneurship, leadership and personal growth. item.title: Loke Yew: The Art of Adapting — and Weaving Worlds Together
